missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Лапа' stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Большая' and 'мягкая' are agreeing feminine adjectives describing the paw.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Лапу' is the accusative direct object of 'поднял'. The feminine ending -а shifts to -у in the accusative. 'Переднюю' agrees in the feminine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Лапы' takes the genitive after 'нет' to express that a paw is missing. The feminine genitive singular ends in -ы.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Лапе' takes the prepositional after 'на' to show where the wound is. The feminine prepositional singular ends in -е.
Strategic focus: Instrumental as means. 'Лапой' takes the instrumental, the case of the body part doing the waving. The feminine instrumental singular ends in -ой.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Лапе' takes the dative after 'к', showing movement toward the paw. The feminine dative singular ends in -е. 'Мягкой' agrees.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Лапы' is the nominative plural subject. 'Сильные' and 'передние' agree in the plural, describing the bear's front paws.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'Лапах' takes the prepositional plural after 'в' to show where the claws are hidden. The plural ends in -ах.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Лапу' is the accusative direct object of 'пожала', the playful idiom for shaking paws. 'Мне' marks the recipient of the gesture.

missions.phrase: Без одной лапы птица не летает.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Лапы' takes the genitive after 'без' to express absence. 'Одной' agrees in the feminine genitive.
